issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares the lecture attributes as private (indicated by '-') and the solution implements them as private fields, but the template exposes two attributes as public (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about encapsulation and whether they should access fields directly or use getters/setters, and may mislead them when implementing the remaining attributes and accessor methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template's attributes private to match the UML and the solution. Update template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to declare lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents (and any added attributes) as private and keep the TODOs for getters/setters and constructor so students implement them via the intended encapsulated API.
